query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever this afternoon, he chased a butterfly all the way across the neighborhood park and ended up rolling in a patch of clover, I had to wipe his paws three times before I let him back in the house. Oh, and I tried that new matcha latte from the café down the street on my way home, it was way less bitter than the one I usually get, I think I’m going to order it again tomorrow. Also, I spent half an hour rearranging my bookshelf earlier, I finally sorted all my fiction novels by genre instead of just shoving them on the shelf randomly, it looks so much neater now. Anyway, I need to exchange some items from my delivered order #W2378156. I want to change the items with SKUs 1151293680 and 4983901480 to 7706410293 and 7747408585 respectively, and please use the payment method credit_card_9513926 for any additional fees related to this exchange.
